description: Long-lived Native Desktop performance runtime gates. This layer proves Native Tauri DOM anchors, runtime cells, and the runtime matrix without using one runtime as evidence for another.

logic.question: Can each Native Desktop runtime cell report an explicit sampled, blocked, or diagnostic-incomplete state?
logic.invariant: tauri-webview-dev and tauri-webview-packaged evidence must remain separate and cohort-identical; one Native runtime cell cannot impersonate another.
